steps.message:
Execute: adb shell "cat <<'SQL' | sqlite3 /data/user/0/com.flauschcode.broccoli/databases/broccoli
BEGIN;
DELETE FROM recipes_with_categories
WHERE recipeId IN (
  SELECT r1.recipeId
  FROM recipes r1
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM recipes r2
    WHERE r2.recipeId < r1.recipeId
      AND r2.title IS r1.title
      AND r2.imageName IS r1.imageName
      AND r2.description IS r1.description
      AND r2.servings IS r1.servings
      AND r2.preparationTime IS r1.preparationTime
      AND r2.source IS r1.source
      AND r2.ingredients IS r1.ingredients
      AND r2.directions IS r1.directions
      AND r2.favorite = r1.favorite
  )
);
DELETE FROM recipes
WHERE recipeId IN (
  SELECT r1.recipeId
  FROM recipes r1
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM recipes r2
    WHERE r2.recipeId < r1.recipeId
      AND r2.title IS r1.title
      AND r2.imageName IS r1.imageName
      AND r2.description IS r1.description
      AND r2.servings IS r1.servings
      AND r2.preparationTime IS r1.preparationTime
      AND r2.source IS r1.source
      AND r2.ingredients IS r1.ingredients
      AND r2.directions IS r1.directions
      AND r2.favorite = r1.favorite
  )
);
INSERT INTO recipes_fts(recipes_fts) VALUES('rebuild');
COMMIT;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
  SELECT 1
  FROM recipes
  GROUP BY title, imageName, description, servings, preparationTime, source, ingredients, directions, favorite
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
);
SQL
am force-stop com.flauschcode.broccoli"
